deployments_detail.use: Drone-based remote inspection of port crane structures, using drones to inspect traditionally hard-to-reach crane areas (completed proof-of-concept/pilot with LRQA classification services). [LRQA]

Group-wide generative AI / enterprise search built on Google Cloud Vertex AI to transform employee/knowledge search experience across Adani Group (which includes Adani Ports); part of migration of 250+ business-critical applications including SAP HANA to Google Cloud. [Google Cloud (Vertex AI)]

AI-augmented terminal operating and optimization platform (Kaleris N4 TOS + Advanced Optimization) to automate container handling, yard planning, crane scheduling and resource allocation. deployments_detail.value: 8 semi-automated ship-to-shore cranes and 23 automatic yard cranes; ~10 minutes per container unload

deployments_detail.use: AI- and sensor-based Vessel Traffic Management System (VTMS/VTS) at Vizhinjam integrating radar, AIS, CCTV, weather stations and VHF with AI on an electronic chart overlay to track vessels in real time, cut turnaround times and improve navigational safety - developed with IIT Madras and Maritime Technology Pvt Ltd. [IIT Madras; Maritime Technology Pvt Ltd]
deployments_detail.value: Managed 29 vessels and 60,000+ containers in one month during trials

deployments_detail.use: IoT-enabled digital twin / 3D operations monitoring: a 3-D digital view of Mundra and Hazira ports integrated with live operations data feed, displayed on 3D video walls for real-time monitoring and exception handling, and used for 3D operator training.

Advanced cargo handling system at Adani Krishnapatnam Port with automated tracking, real-time data analysis and logistics coordination to improve speed, accuracy and safety for containerized and bulk cargo.
Customer-facing chatbot answering customer questions and providing real-time cargo/shipping information to improve customer service, as part of Adani Ports' digital transformation.
